title: Reactions
summary: Emoji reactions under a message: a chip per emoji with its count, the person's own reactions highlighted, a tap toggles, a long press shows who reacted.

includesOwn.description: true when the person reacted with it.

senders.description: ReactionSenderData of each sender, oldest first.

chips.description: In the order the SDK gives (first reaction first). More than 6 chips fold into a +N chip.

whoSheet.description: The emoji whose sender list is open.

toggle.effect: Timeline.toggleReaction with the item id and the key. The chip updates at once (local echo).

showSenders.effect: Opens a sheet with one tab per emoji and the names of the senders.

pickEmoji.effect: Opens the system emoji keyboard; the chosen emoji runs toggle.

notes: In an encrypted room the reaction emoji sits in m.relates_to, which the Matrix spec keeps outside the encryption, so the server can see it. Do not promise more.
bipe_app_reaction_label is the accessibility label of a chip: %1$s the emoji, %2$s the count formatted by the system.
No custom image reactions in phase 1. Stickers are separate (parity stickers).
